title: Club Membership: amenities included by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for every Club Membership tier, whether sauna access, pool access (where the club has one), complimentary towel service, and complimentary childcare are included, and how many childcare hours per week where childcare is included.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Sauna access | Pool access | Towel service | Childcare included | Childcare hours per week |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | No | No | No | No | 0 |
| Student Metro Access | No | No | No | No | 0 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | No | No | No | No | 0 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | No | Yes | No | No | 0 |
| Premier All-Access | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | 0 |
| Black Card All-Access | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 6 |
| Founding Legacy Access | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | 0 |

## Reading the table
Pool access is included only where the club location the member visits itself has a pool. Childcare hours per week is 0 for every tier that does not include complimentary childcare; only Black Card All-Access includes complimentary childcare, at 6 hours per week.
